title: On a family of one-dimensional oscillation inequalities
summary: Let $\varphi$ be a nonzero continuous mean-zero function on the one-dimensional torus and let $N_\varphi$ be the number of times that $\varphi$ changes signs. We prove the sharp family of oscillation inequalities of the types \begin{equation*} N_\varphi\|\varphi\|_{\dot W^{-1,s}} \gtrsim_{p,s} \frac{\|\varphi\|_1^{1+p'/s}}{\|\varphi\|_p^{p'/s}} \, \, \text{ and } \, \, (N_\varphi)^α\|φ\|_{\dot W^{-1,s}} \gtrsim_{p,q,r,s,α} \frac{\|\varphi\|_p\|\varphi\|_q}{\|\varphi\|_r}. \end{equation*} This resolves an open problem posed by S.
